note: What a server sends to make a unit play an animation. The header names the unit.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: unusedLow
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

bits.name: loop
bits.note: Set to loop the animation: it starts over once it ends.

bits.name: holdLastFrame
bits.note: Set to hold the last frame once the animation ends; it stops advancing there. Wins over loop.

bits.name: fadeOthers
bits.note: Set to freeze the animations already playing and fade them to nothing over the blend time. They are not removed.

bits.name: freezeOthers
bits.note: Set to freeze the animations already playing, fade them out over the blend time, then remove them.

bits.name: dropOthers
bits.note: Set to remove the animations already playing at once, with no fade.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: How the animation plays, as a set of bits.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: Where above zero, how many seconds the animation is stretched or squeezed to span; otherwise it plays at normal speed.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: Every play blends in over a blend time of 0.2 seconds. Without loop or holdLastFrame, an animation that ends is removed, except that where it was the unit's only animation and the unit has an idle, a client fades back to the idle, looping. No start point is carried: the animation starts from its beginning.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: loop
bits.note: Set to loop it.

bits.name: holdLastFrame
bits.note: Set to hold its last frame once it ends.

bits.name: queue
bits.note: Set to play it once the animation playing ends, rather than now.

bits.name: queueLast
bits.note: Set to play it after every animation already waiting.

bits.name: replaceable
bits.note: Set to let the next animation queued after it start at once.

bits.name: locked
bits.note: Set where the unit ignores this message while the animation plays.

bits.name: noBlend
bits.note: Set to switch to it at once rather than blend in.

bits.name: lockedFromIdle
bits.note: Set where idle animations cannot fade it out.

bits.name: reserved
bits.note: What it does is not recorded for this range; a server writes zero.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: How the animation plays.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: Where above zero, how many seconds the animation is stretched or squeezed to last.

fields.name: animation
fields.note: The animation's name, ended by a zero byte, the two taking at most 64 bytes. Nothing plays for a name the unit does not have.

revisions.note: A unit playing a locked animation ignores the message. A client stops any emote playing first, and plays at normal speed.

fields.note: How the animation plays.

fields.name: scaleTime
fields.note: A scale on how long it plays. A client ignores it.

revisions.note: A client ignores scaleTime and startProgress, and plays at normal speed from the start. A unit holding a locked animation ignores the message. An animated building plays at normal speed, and keepEmotes has no effect on it.
